# Archive vs reproduction

Archive: 4080 SUPER runs recorded in the internal experiment log (full-precision values from the archived `*_metrics.json`).
Repro: 2080 Ti ten-seed sweep in this repository.
The two hosts differ; see `PROVENANCE.md` for the paired same-GPU proof that the code is equivalent.
